correctness.rationale: Case analysis on five consecutive colors proves the Boolean triple-AND flip identity. Iteration yields the exact initial alternating-window criterion and complete recurrent-state classification with sharp odd/even maximum fixation times. Uniform initial letters give p=(q-1)/q^(2t+2), overlapping-hit joint probability p/q^s for 1<=s<=2t+1, and independent disjoint blocks. A boundary-trimmed length-sqrt(n) blocking argument proves Poisson(λ) when λ is bounded and q increases; union bound and variance establish the outer regimes. A standalone exhaustive program independently checks 24 finite (q,n) cases and all 5^7 length-seven local inputs. Limits of finite verification are explicit.

value.rationale: An entire natural class of synchronous cyclic plurality systems has a complete dynamical classification and exact sharp fixation clocks. More importantly, allowing q to vary with network size creates a sequence of distinct critical palette scales n^(1/(2t+1)) and a two-point limiting fixation-time law. These give nontrivial, quantitative threshold predictions for multicolor consensus networks, unlike a routine fixed-alphabet color relabeling.
